name: slide-defense-weaver
description: Understand your project, discuss slide order, and weave a coherent defense story with mock Q&A and tough-question rehearsal.

interface.shortDescription: Tell one coherent story across your slides.
interface.longDescription: Reads your project materials and slides, discusses the narrative and slide order with you, then prepares a slide-by-slide defense script, mock Q&A, and tough-question rehearsal as three Word files.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Slide Defense Weaver to read my project and PPT, confirm time, discuss the story, then prepare my defense.
